option.value: 7S|normally we would use warehouse legal name as first name and last name, but 7S need some specific carrier HUB names which we define as warehouse contact person

NEKOM|if we get here, it is because we have imported the SO from another integration (e.g., Elten uses NEKOM to import OTTO SOs) this means that the SO id will have changed (e.g., SO id in an OTTO system is 123, but in NEKOM it is 345, so we set the SO external_id to 345 during import) in this case, we need to make another request to get the OTTO SO number, which does match in both OTTO & NEKOM
